title: Air Conditioning — Trim Air Duct Outlet Flange — Inspection of the Sensor Boss Land Before Conversion
abstract: Inspection of the trim air duct outlet flange land before the standard 2 conversion, to confirm that the flange is fit to carry a welded sensor boss and to reject ducts that have already been reworked at that station.

sections.planning_reason: The standard 2 conversion welds a sensor boss into the duct outlet flange, and a weld into a flange that has already been dressed or reworked is not acceptable. A survey of ninety in-service ducts found eleven with local dressing at the outlet flange, always where a leak had been chased at some point in the aircraft's life. Welding a boss onto a dressed flange leaves too little material at the weld toe and the joint would not meet its fatigue substantiation. This inspection separates the ducts that can be converted from those that need replacement, before the operator commits to the conversion kit.
sections.description: This Service Bulletin is an inspection only. The trim air duct outlet flange at each zone valve station is examined for previous rework, for thickness against the minimum given in the instructions, and for surface indications. The result is recorded so that the operator knows before ordering the conversion kit whether a replacement duct section is also required. Nothing is modified and no part is fitted.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Make sure that the air conditioning system is depressurised. Get access through the ceiling panels in zones 254 and 291. Remove the zone valve at FIN 726HQ and the zone valve at FIN 980HQ following task AMM-Z-21-60-11-000-023-A. Clean the duct outlet flange face. Do a detailed visual inspection of the flange land for evidence of previous dressing, for scoring and for corrosion. Measure the flange thickness at eight positions around the bore with an ultrasonic thickness gauge and record every reading. Do a dye penetrant inspection of the flange land and record any indication. Compare the readings with the minimum thickness table in this bulletin. Report the result to Aeralis on the attached form. Install the valves following task AMM-Z-21-60-11-400-023-A and do the trim air system operational test.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to ZEPHYR-20, ZEPHYR-22 and ZEPHYR-24 aircraft that are not yet at the standard 2 trim air regulation configuration and that are intended to be converted. Aircraft already converted have had this inspection performed as part of the conversion and are not affected.
sections.material_note: No kit is required. Consumables for the dye penetrant inspection and the flange cleaning are operator supplied. Duct sections found unacceptable are ordered separately against the reported result.

type_data.compliance_time: Before the embodiment of the standard 2 conversion, and in any case before the conversion kit is ordered.
